name: secrets
description: Secret presence checker + local vault. 'check' reports which env vars every tool manifest declares and whether each is set (env or vault) — values are never printed. 'run' injects vault vars into a child process env so secrets never touch stdout or argv.
use_when: checking which credentials are missing, storing keys safely, running a command with secrets injected

args.name: check
args.description: List declared env vars with in_env/in_vault booleans.

args.name: set NAME
args.description: Store a secret — value read from stdin, never argv.

args.name: del NAME / list
args.description: Remove a secret / list vault names only.

args.name: run -- cmd...
args.description: Exec a command with vault vars injected into its env.

stdout: JSON status only — secret values are never emitted.
notes: Vault is plaintext-at-rest under the user's state dir — for real keyring integration use system tools; this covers agent-workflow convenience.
